balls.text: Finishes it with a boundary! That's his second century of the season, his second for CSK and his fifth in the IPL! Takes on the short ball and nails the pull over square leg, and it lands just short of the boundary. Samson celebrates, and walks off, getting a hug from his India T20I captain Suryakumar Yadav as he does so. What a sublime innings this has been, and it's taken CSK to a fighting score of 207
Low full toss outside off, he looks to take it on and gets an inside edge to short fine leg. Single not taken again
Creamed over cover! CSK go past 200 as Samson reaches out to this full and wide delivery and lofts it inside out
Nails the wide yorker now, 138.6kph, and Samson looks to heave it away but can only get it down to long-on off the inside half. Samson doesn't take the single
Oh, good comeback from Krish Bhagat! 137kph length ball outside off and it beats Samson's drive
Samson has hit this well over deep midwicket! Samson into the 90s as he dispatches this short ball outside off.
Full outside off, eased to long-on and Samson keeps strike

Oh, Samson you beauty! He premeditated this. Took a few steps forward and got ready for the scoop, anticipating the yorker. Fired in at 138kph and he uses the pace beautifully to scoop it very fine on the leg side and it goes all the way
Bumrah fires in another yorker, but it goes down leg. And Bumrah has overstepped! Free Hit incoming
Lovely dipping yorker around off. Hosein manages to work it into the midwicket region and gets Samson back on strike
Low full toss on leg, clipped out to deep midwicket
Low full toss outside off, Hosein manages to work it through the vacant midwicket region
Low full toss on the pads, flicked away to deep midwicket
Oh, he's sliced it to the deep point fielder! Slashes at this full and wide delivery. He hit it hard, but it was straight to the fielder. Naman Dhir makes no mistake. Overton's cameo is done
Overton lofts this down the ground Overpitched by Ashwani and Overton clears his front leg and hits this well straight of long-on
Slower bouncer and Overton is beaten by the lack of pace
Length ball angled across, it stays a bit low to beat Overton's attempted pull
Oh, he finds the gap. This is a slower ball, full outside off, Overton hits an aerial drive, but bisects mid-off and cover nicely
Short ball angled across, Overton leaves it alone as the umpire signals wide
Oh, neatly played! Uses his long reach to get the bat down with an open face and steer this wide yorker fine of deep third for a boundary
In the blockhole around off, Overton squeezes it out to deep cover. Just two runs and a wicket from the over. Sublime

Oh, that's brilliant from Santner! Full toss around off, Kartik looks to flick it away, but hits it flat towards deep square leg. Santner moves to his left and forward and then dives in front to take it low! Santner looks like he's injured his shoulder, though. He goes off the field for treatment, but he's helped Bumrah get his first wicket of the day
Low full toss outside off, Kartik hits his drive straight to extra cover. So that's another dot
Brilliant yorker outside off, this time with pace off, blocked back to Bumrah
Kartik Sharma for the first time gets an experience of a Jasprit Bumrah yorker. Speared in on middle, and Kartik does well to block it back out to the bowler
Low full toss outside off, 139kph, square driven to deep point
Short outside off, dabbed to deep third. Good over for Samson and CSK
Short ball, pace off, Samson waits on it and looks to help it fine on the leg side with the pull. But he can't beat the short fine leg fielder
Bhagat is having a tough, tough start! This is another full toss, going down leg. Samson just has to get some bat on it, which he does, and it races away fine on the leg side

Oh, expertly done! Samson is great at this. This is a low full toss aimed at the base of off stump. Samson just brings his bat down with an open face and glides it to short third's right. What placement. Chef's kiss
Samson picks the bones out of that slower ball! This is fed to Samson right in the slot, Samson waits on it and heaves it over long-on
Starts off with a yorker gone wrong! It's a full toss that Samson tries to block, and it goes off the bat sticker to short third. It's okay for height so Bhagat gets away
Arm ball angled across, Kartik misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Ghazanfar appeals, but that was always sliding down leg
Flighted very full around off, driven to the bowler
On a length outside off, he crunches a drive out to deep dover
Full on leg, clipped through midwicket
Arm ball on a length on middle, punched to long-on
On a length outside off, he goes back and punches it down to long-on
A bit short and he rocks back and pulls it down to long-on

Hammered inside out over extra cover! Kartik's happy with that one too. This is tossed up full and just inside the wide line. He gets a big stride to get closer to the pitch of the ball and lifts it over extra cover. Massive hit!
On a length outside off, zipped in flatter and Kartik punches it back to the bowler
Hangs back to this length ball outside off and punches it to point
Oh, that's sublime from Kartik Sharma. He has a big smile on his face, and why shouldn't he? Dances down to this full ball outside off and creams it over long-off and into the stands
Floated full on middle at 89kph, Samson eases it out to long-off
Another short ball. Samson takes it on with the pull. Hits it out to deep midwicket on the bounce
Back of length on leg and going across, Samson leaves it alone
Short and angled across, Kartik pulls it along the ground to deep midwicket
Ashwani beats him with another length ball angled across
Length ball angled across, Kartik looks to play the late cut but can't connect
Short ball angled across, Samson dabs it to deep third's right
Full around off, he presses forward to block
Tossed up real slow and full on middle, Samson works it square on the leg side
Punched down to long-off
Santner slides this length ball down leg
Stands tall and punches this length ball down to long-off
On a length outside off and spinning away, punched out through cover point
Full outside off, driven past a sloppy cover fielder for a single

Ashwani gets the breakthrough! Brevis' ramp finds the fielder Short and angled across at 125kph. Brevis looks to go up and over, but can't force the pace on this one. Bumrah has to take just a few steps in from deep third. Ashwani's impressive season continues
THWACK! Banged in short on leg at 124kph, and Brevis hammers a grounded pull that races across the surface
Full around off, Samson works it down to long-on
Fifty up in some style Ashwani flings a full toss across Samson and he opens the blade to steer it through backward point, getting it past the fielder. Strike rate still above 200
Short of deep midwicket running in. Brevis miscued the pull on this 134kph short ball but Dhir in the deep loses sight of the ball and can't get in enough to make the catch
Slashes hard at this short ball angled across him. Drops short of the backward point fielder, and he can't stop it from bursting through

Deceives him... and that's called a wide. Oh, think that is a harsh call. MI have reviewed the call. Brevis backs away but Santner darts this outside off stump as Brevis lets this go. The ball is close to the tramline, but just inside. The on-field umpire reverses his call
Going, going, gone! Have some of that, Santa says Brevis. Floated outside off stump, Brevis lines him up and smokes this miles over long-off
nicely bowled. Flatter and fuller on off stump, Brevis tries to whack that across the line, but only ends up mistiming onto his boot
Tossed up outside off, he pushes to deep cover with an angled bat
Very slower bowled well outside off stump, marginally short as well. Brevis belts that to deep extra cover
Backs away big time, but Santner spots this and lobs this well outside off. Ends up missing the tramline. Called a wide
Brevis wastes no time. Tossed up just outside off stump, Brevis bends down on one knee and tonks this straight over the bowler's head
Marginally short outside off, he hops back and slaps this to deep point
Darted but the line is down leg again, Samson turns this to deep backward square leg
Flatter on leg stump, he works this to the right of midwicket
A touch slower through the air on leg stump, Samson stays back and works behind square on the legside
Darted on a length on off stump, Brevis carves this to deep backward point for a run

The sweep brings about the undoing of another CSK batter. Carrom ball from Ghazanfar at 89.6kph on off stump, Dube brings out the slog sweep, misses and sees his stumps in a mess. Ghazanfar celebrates and rightly so
Another slower back of a length ball outside off, Dube eyes a pull but is deceived by the lack of pace. He gets a thick inside-edge to the on-side

Oh, he's nicely ridden the bounce there, but only gets a run for his efforts. Slower short of a length ball outside off, he gets on top of the bounce by getting on his toes and steers to the right of deep third
Flicked past short fine leg. Fuller down leg, easy pickings for Samson who clips this neatly away from the fielder
Arches this into Dube at 131.7kph and on a length on middle, he works this to deep backward square leg
Skiddy back of a length ball on middle at 134.1kph, he looks for a pull, but can only manage an inside-edge onto pad
Starts off with a slower back of a length ball angling across Samson, he stands tall and slaps to deep cover
Slower through the air on the fuller side on off, he stretches forward and pushes to deep cover
Flatter and fuller on off stump, he prods forward and eases to long-off
Flatter outside leg stump, he stays legside of the ball and pushes to long-on
Just clears deep midwicket and Samson continues to fly. Dragged down on leg stump, he backs away and pulls over the fielder's head
Length ball on middle, he stays back and turns it to deep midwicket
A touch slower on a length on middle, he prods forward and defends
Angled in on middle stump, he pushes back to the bowler
Oh, here's the Santner version of a bouncer, right out of Krunal's book. Banged in short at 109kph, he pulls to deep midwicket

CLEANS HIM UP! Santner has the last laugh and Safaraz is a goner. Lovely flight and dip on this from Santner. Bowls this fuller at 75.2kph on middle and leg, Sarfaraz looks for a sweep, misses and sees his leg stump pegged back
Pushed quicker on off stump, he opens the face of the bat but only steers it to short third
Two in two! Same region, different shot, same result. Long-hop on middle stump, he goes deep and pulls for a one-bounce four around the deep midwicket region
The sweep comes out right away! Tossed  up on off stump, a hint of turn and Safaraz picks this up in front of deep square leg
Another attempted yorker but this ends up being a low full toss on middle and leg. Sarfaraz works this to deep backward square leg
Here he goes with the yorker! Nails it at 141.1kph on middle stump, Sarfaraz somehow gets his bat down in time.
Skiddy back of a length ball outside off, he slashes at it and gets it down to deep third

PULLED FOR SIX! Slower bouncer but Samson was waiting for it and he's clobbered that all the way. On middle stump, he gets inside the line and the ball clears the cushion around the deep square leg region
Pacy back of a length ball outside off, he guides to deep third
And he's on the attack, right away! A touch fuller on off stump, Sarfaraz goes straight over the bowler's head and with precision
Ooh, the deft touch again and another Hardik over that's gone for 19. Slower offcutter outside off, he waits for it before gently dabbing to the right of short third

Slower bouncer outside off stump, but that is too high. Samson eyes the ramp but is unable to do so. Called a wide. Hardik feels he's heard a noise, so does Tilak but de Kock shakes his head and rightly so.

4, 6, 4! A misfield and Samson is flying. Back of a length ball outside off stump, he opens the face of the blade and steers to the right of Bumrah who doesn't stretch his right hand wide enough and the ball sneaks through
On his pad and Samson needs no second invitations there. He gets inside the line, goes right back and flicks him nonchalantly over deep backward square leg.
Goes awry with his line and Samson cashes in. Back of a length ball down leg, Samson gets a little glove on his pull and the ball flies to the left of de Kock
On a length on off and middle, Samson pushes to mid-on with a straight face of the bat
On a length on off stump, he pushes to mid-on

Straight down long-off's throat and Ghazanfar is once again MI's powerplay enforcer. Quicker on leg stump rather just outside. Gaikwad backs away looking to go straight down the ground; the shot was on but he just doesn't get enough power behind it and Tilak runs to his right from long-off and after a slight bobble completes the catch
Off the front of the hand, was a length ball outside off, he pats to point
Flatter on middle and leg, Samson works this to the right of square leg but only for a run
Flatter length ball on off stump, Gaikwad ticks this to mid-on and sets off
Oh, nonchalance! Darted on a length on off stump, with a flick of the wrists Gaikwad flicks this to the right of mid-on
Flatter skiddy legbreak outside off, Gaikwad defends to cover point
Length ball on Gaikwad's pads, he turns this to deep backward square leg for a run
On a length outside off stump, Gaikwad punches to extra cover
Add six more to the score! Bouncer on middle and leg, and Gaikwad was expecting that. Gets inside the line of that and hooks over the deep fine leg fence

Nails the yorker but Gaikwad squeezes this past short third. Full swinging away outside off stump, he shapes up to play the cover drive but can only manage a thick outside edge. Gets four nonetheless.
Fuller angling well outside off stump past the tramline. A wide called, so the free-hit stands.

Swishes that away across the line for four! Good length ball outside off stump, wasn't short enough but Gaikwad bends his knees, stays low and pulls through midwicket. The siren is off again; Hardik has overstepped now.
Good length ball angling back into Gaikwad around off stump, he stands tall and defends
Short of a good length ball outside off stump, Gaikwad gets on top of the bounce and flays this away with an open face of the bat to the right of deep third

Oof! That's some way to defend a free-hit. Nails the inswinging yorker right on middle stump. Samson is deep in his crease but there's no way he's getting under that as the ball pins him on the pad. Bumrah smiles and appeals and then gives it out.

WOWZA! That's Samson at his absolute best. Length ball well outside off, not a lot of swing. Samson steps forward and absolutely laces the cover drive. Hang on, the siren goes off. Bumrah has overstepped.
Ona a length on off stump, he defends back to the bowler

Rushes him and pings him on the peek of the helmet! Sharp skiddy bouncer at 138kph on middle stump, Gaikwad is late on the pull and is hit right on the emblem. The physio comes out for a mandatory concussion test
Fullish in length outside off stump, Gaikwad takes a couple of steps down the track, reaches for the ball and pushes to extra cover

On the fuller side of length, he prods forward and creams a drive but only as far as Rutherford at cover point. Oh, dear, he lobs a throw way over de Kock's head and concedes an overthrow. CSK are off the mark
Starts off with a length ball decking back into Samson on off stump. He defends with soft hands

Edged and taken! Chennai Super Kings have inflicted on Mumbai Indians their biggest defeat by runs in IPL history! Sanju Samson and Akeal Hosein the stars of a famous El Clasico triumph for Chennai Super Kings today. This was a back of length ball angled across and Bumrah tries to jab at it, ends up giving Samson a catch to wrap up a win that he started with the bat
Low full toss, from around the wicket. Bumrah hits it back towards his left but he sticks his arm out and makes a good stop
Looks for the yorker on middle and leg, Ashwani digs it out towards mid-on
Full on off, driven to mid-off
Pace off length ball angled across, Bumrah waits on it and steers it to deep third
Beats everything. Bumrah has a swing at this length ball and misses and the ball sails over the stumps
Yorker outside off, Ashwani can't touch it
Full around leg, smashed back to the bowler as he hits it into the ground

Full around middle, hit down the ground and Ashwani races for the single. Bumrah is not interested and the throw from Brevis misses both sets of stumps. Samson hadn't bother running up to the stumps, otherwise that may have been that
Short on leg and angled across, Ashwani can't get a bat on it as he tries to short-arm pull
Full outside off, flicked towards midwicket's left and they race off for a single. The throw misses the stumps at the non-striker's end and hits Bumrah's bat
Short on off, Bumrah looks to hook but is beaten. Called wide on height

And another one goes! This is floated full outside off, Thakur looks to go downtown but miscues the slower ball. Goes off the toe end and it's a good catch by Brevis after he has to run in from long-on to get under it
And that's another one gone. Overton has his first of the game as Krish Bhagat's vigil comes to an end. Full around middle and leg, he looks to flick it away, but hits it straight to deep fine leg
On a length outside off, blocked to point
Short ball angled across, Bhagat looks to get inside the line and hook it over, but can't connect
143.1k length ball outside off, blocked back

Great diving stop by Sanju. Length ball angled across, 143kph, Shardul looks to whip it leg side and hits it onto his pads and it goes well to Samson's left. He does well to make the stop, even if it may technically go down as a dropped chance
Looks to flick this full ball on off, hits it into this pad. It drops to his left and Overton is quick to race across and prevent a single
Flashes at this length ball angled across, can't get anything on it
Length ball angled across, punched to extra cover
Length ball angled across, steered out through point
Looks for the pull on this short ball and gets a top edge over the keeper. Overton at deep third does well to lumber across and put in a dive to stop the boundary
On a length outside leg, clipped away through square leg
Flashes a length ball across him, he looks to drive but can't connect
On a length outside off and spinning away, he looks for the cut and misses out. Noor bowls out with figures of 2 for 23
Punched out to deep cover
Tucks this length ball square off his pads. Sarfaraz at short leg lets it through
Hit straight to Dube at short cover, but it was a bump ball. Tossed up very full outside off and Bhagat hit a drive into the ground and to short cover
Full outside off, pushed out towards point
Full outside off, driven out through cover

Full on middle and spinning away, Bhagat pushes it out square on the off side and gets a single. Akeal Hosein finishes with stunning figures of 4 for 17 -- the best of the season going past Overton's 4 for 18

Is that another one? Samson is convinced. Bhagat was stretching forward and misses his drive as the ball spins away. But Bhagat's back foot was firmly planted behind the crease by the time Samson took the bails off
Full outside off, it holds in the pitch as Shardul pushes at it. Goes uppishly, but too wide of Hosein
Full on leg, flicked away through midwicket
Tossed up on middle and leg, driven back to the bowler

Akeal has the fourth, and it's Mumbai Indians' last real hope - Suryakumar Yadav! Not quite full enough for the sweep as he tosses it up around middle and off, he gets a big top edge and it balloons up to deep backward square. Sarfaraz Khan runs in and grabs it
Floated full outside off, SKY eases a drive down to long-off
Tossed up full outside leg, he looks for the sweep andends up hitting it onto his pads and it goes behind square on the leg side
What a ripper! Noor angles it in and pitches it full outside off, but it's the googly that spins away past the outside edge
Full outside off, Shardul brings out a lovely front-foot defence

Two in two! Rutherford has hit this straight down deep cover's throat. Tossed up full and wide and Rutherford looks to go inside out. Ends up slicing it, and doesn't get the height and distance needed on that one. CSK on top

Hardik is gone second ball! Ungainly hoick as he tries to swing across the line on this full ball on middle. Gets nothing but a top edge. Mukesh Choudhary runs to his left from short third and gobbles it up
Offbreak outside off, spinning away. punched away to deep cover

Chopped on! Akeal has his third! Rohit Sharma has an astonished look in the dugout, while Akeal looks completely unmoved. Quick and flat, fired across him. Tilak looks to swing it away and ends up dragging it on. The form man is out for Mumbai Indians
Full around off, and it almost sneaks in under SKY's sweep through backward square leg. He does get enough on it to put it away for a single
Full outside off and it spins away. SKY looks to go inside out and doesn't quite get a hold of it. It clears the infield, but there is protection in the deep there
Flat, on a length around middle, whipped away through midwicket for a couple
Zips this across Tilak, who cuts it away to deep point
Tossed up on leg, flicked away through midwicket as they ease their way to two
Now Tilak looks to go down the ground but can't hit it as well as he'd have liked. Goes to long-on on the bounce
Shot! That's a man in form. Dances down the pitch and even as Noor tosses it wide of him, he reaches out and flays this over cover
Tossed up full outside leg, swept fine off the inside half towards short fine's right
Looks to straight-drive this full ball, but hits it straight to the bowler
Quick, flat arm ball outside off, chopped to backward point

slower offcutter on middle stump, he turns this to deep midwicket for a run. He wants a second but is sent back by Surya. Oh, hello, some words exchanged between Tilak and Overton. Sky joins in as well. Overton isn't pleased and the umpire has a word with him
Length ball around off stump, he pushes to backward point
On a length on off stump, he pushes to covers for a quick run
Thumped over covers and Tilak is up and away now! Length ball outside off stump, he stays still and lifts it clean to the deep extra cover fence
Length ball on middle and leg, he works this to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs
Tilak stepping on the pedal now. Back of a length ball angling across Tilak, he uses the width and cuts past backward point.
Belted straight back past the bowler and Surya collects an important boundary. Floated on middle stump, he backs away, giving himself room and thumps this to the left of Noor.
Darted just around off stump, Tilak eyes a cross-batted swipe but only gets it off the inside-half of the bat to deep backward square leg
Flatter at 93.9kph turning away from Surya, who pushes firmly to long-off
Flatter length ball that hurries onto Tilak on middle, he works to the on-side with soft hands
Tossed up around off stump, Suryakumar punches to long-off
Tossed up outside off, he drives to extra cover
Oh, dear, he's lost his radar big time first ball. Looks to go flatter and sends it waaaaay down leg. Is lucky that Dube puts in a dive at short fine leg and saves a few extras
The inside-edge saves him. On a length decking back into Tilak on off stump, he gets a thick inside-edge onto pad. The batters take a quick single with the ball going to the offside
Length ball angling away from SKY well outside off, he scythes that to deep backward point
Attempted slower bouncer but that's too high. Bangs this halfway into the surface and the ball flies over SKY's head. Called a wide
HAMMERED! Rising back of a length ball outside off, SKY stands tall and punches with authority through covers. The two blows might have woken him up
SKY finally gets one away. Length ball angling away from SKY, who opens the face of the bat and places it well to the left of deep point
On a length around off stump, he pushes to sweeper cover for a run
SHOT! Back of a length ball outside off stump, the width was the key and Tilak latches onto it by cutting past backward point

Oh, he's hit again, this time on the box. And SKY is down on his haunches.  Length ball veering back into SKY on off stump, he eyes the supla shot again, misses and is hurt. Flings his bat away, takes a couple of deep breaths and is okay to continue
Sharp length ball on off stump, SKY pushes to extra cover. No run there

Hits him on the elbow! Ouch! That will be painful.  Length ball on off stump, SKY shuffles across and looks for a scoop/flick. Only manages a thick edge that thuds into his back elbow. He immediately drops his bat and walks way. The physio is out to take a look. SKY is standing in a teapot stance. The magic spray has worked, SKY is good to continue
On a length angling back into SKY on off and middle, he ticks this to midwicket
On a length on off stump, he stays back and pushes to sweeper cover for a run
back of  a length ball just around off stump, he opens the face of the bat but only guides to backward point
Full on off stump, he pushes to mid-off and sets off. There is a direct throw at the striker's end but SKY is home. MI end the powerplay on 29 for 3, their lowest this season
Too wide again. Lots of movement for Mukesh but the ball is starting well outside off and continues well past the tramline
Back of a length delivery bowled well outside off stump, but that's a bit too wide
Rising back of a length ball on off stump, Tilak is right behind it and defends
On a length just around off stump, Tilak defends back to the bowler
They're bowling to their fields so far. On a length outside off, he stands tall and punches with an angled but there is a sweeper cover back
On a length angling well across Surya. He almost sweeps himself off his feet in trying to drive that through covers. Cue-ends to extra cover
Back of a length ball outside off, he slices to deep backward point

Suryakumar has to scramble back to make the crease. Full on off stump, he pushes this authoritatively back to the bowler and takes a couple of steps down the track. Kamboj fires a throw back and Surya has to put in a sprawling dive. Kamboj missed his mark, nevertheless
Full on off stump, he presents the full face of the bat and pushes back to the bowler
On the fuller side of length on off stump, he pushes to mid-off with a straight face of the bat and they take a quick run

Slashes, gets a thick outside edge and gets four. Not where he was intending that to go, but he won't mind. On a length on the stumps, he gives himself some room and looks to go inside-out over covers. Gets a thickish outside edge that flies over short third
Short of a good length ball on middle stump, he shuffles across and works this to deep backward square leg
Fuller-length ball delivered outside off stump, Tilak stretches forward and drives firmly on the up but there is a sweeper cover in place
Back of a length ball angling away from Surya, this time he mistimes to covers
Width and SKY latches on. Length ball angling away from SKY but he's given lots of room. He steers this with an open face of the bat to the right of short third
Length ball angling away from Surya outside off, he mistimes towards mid-off
On a length just outside off stump, shaping away from Tilak. He pushes at it and gets a thick outside edge to the left of backward point. They take a quick run
Good pace! Short of a good length ball decking back sharply into Tilak striking him in the midriff at 139.3kph
On a length with a hint of nibble away from Suryakumar, who pushes to the right of mid-off for a run
A wicket-maiden for Akeal! Just the fourth maiden bowled this season. He goes slower now on off stump, Tilak prods forward and defends
Arm ball angling away from Tilak outside off, he can only tap this to the on-side
Tossed up on off, he defends back to the bowler

Three in three overs for CSK... Akeal what a STAR! Turn and grip and bounce and timber! Lands this on a length at 90.6kph on middle and leg, the ball pitches and turns away from Dhir who is beaten all ends while attempting a cross-batted waft. The stumps are in a mess!
Slower through the air at 87kph just outside off, he stays back and slaps this to cover-point
Flatter and fuller on off stump, he pushes back to the bowler
SKY is away in style! Length ball on his pads and those are easy pickings for SKY who flicks this with ease through midwicket

Four dots and a wicket! Mukesh has started with a wicket as well. Raises his finger and then looks up to the heavens to celebrate. Been a tough few days for him with the passing of his mother. On a length just outside off, de Kock pushes at it with hard hands, gets a thick inside-edge with the ball crashing into the stumps
Four straight dots! Back of a length delivery outside off, he punches firmly but straight to backward point on the bounce
Three dots! Short of a good length ball decking away from de Kock outside off, he opens the face of the blade but can't beat backward point
Sharp back of a length ball on off, he steers to short third. No run there
Fuller angling on off stump, he pushes firmly to mid-off

A golden duck for Malewar! This is much slower than his previous five deliveries, he gets some turn and bite and strikes early.
